crossRefs.note: “Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!”
“Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Get away from around the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram!’ ”
He spoke to the congregation, saying, “Depart, please, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs…
They fell on their faces, and said, “God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and will you be angry…
Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and fell on their faces.…
David lifted up his eyes, and saw Yahweh’s angel standing between earth and the sky, having a drawn sword in his hand…
He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away…

translations.web: “Get away from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!” They fell on their faces.
translations.bsb: “Get away from this congregation so that I may consume them in an instant.” And Moses and Aaron fell facedown.
translations.kjv: Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them as in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.
translations.asv: Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.
